description: Solana transaction verification by signature: slot, success, fee, balance changes. When to use: confirm a Solana payment or program call before releasing value. Data source: external Solana JSON-RPC (no self-hosted Solana node). Returns: found, slot, block_time, success, error, fee_lamports/fee_sol, accounts, logs, and the first 12 account balance deltas. Free: no metering.
name: sol_get_transaction
